<thought>We need to find the template that was used to generate the precursors for the Still‑Gennari reaction. The target molecule (product) is the first SMILES in the precursor pairs: C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO. The reaction forms a C‑C double bond and a carboxylic ester, while breaking a C‑P bond, a C‑C bond, and a C‑O bond. We'll search the template catalog with these criteria to obtain the template_id and mapped_rxn.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["C-P", "C-O", "C-C"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bond", "carboxylic ester"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
